revenueGates.name: Pre-proof
revenueGates.decision: Do not add retainers, ads, new freelancers, new certification pathways, or non-critical software.

revenueGates.name: Survival proof
revenueGates.decision: Keep burn low. Only reinvest into proven conversion, delivery, analytics, and sales follow-up.

revenueGates.name: Healthy early proof
revenueGates.decision: Allow limited reinvestment into proven revenue paths.

revenueGates.name: Strong niche signal
revenueGates.decision: Controlled scaling may begin, with burn review and proof-based spending.

expansionAllowedWhenAtLeastTwoAreTrue: Refund or complaint rate is manageable
Lead source is known and repeatable
